info.title: Lumo Task API
info.description:
REST API for Lumo Task — an Eisenhower-matrix task manager.

**This document is generated** from the route registry in `@lumo/contracts` (`src/registry.ts`) and the Zod schemas it references. It is never hand-edited, and a parity test fails the build if it stops matching the routes the server actually mounts.

**Authentication:** every `/v1/*` route requires a Bearer token except the auth and OAuth handshake endpoints. Call `POST /v1/auth/signin` to obtain one, then click **Authorize** and paste it.

**Errors** all share one envelope: `{ error: { code, message, fields? } }`.
